enrichment.summary: ACC Environmental Consultants will do soil sampling, hazardous material testing, a hazardous material survey, data review and report writing for the Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project. The total includes up to $6,963.50 for additional services. Work is scheduled from October 27, 2022 to November 10, 2023 and is paid from Measure Y bond funds.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: General Services Agreement – ACC Environmental Consultants – Roosevelt Middle School Moderinzation Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Adds $35,137.04 to G & G Builders' Burckhalter Elementary site improvements contract
enrichment.summary: This change order adds work for unforeseen conditions at Burckhalter Elementary School: demolishing asphalt, new asphalt paving and installing a concrete rat slab. It raises the contract's not-to-exceed amount from $59,813.00 to $94,950.04. All other contract terms stay the same. It is paid from Measure J bond funds.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Change Order No. 1, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - G & G Builders, Inc. – Burckhalter Elementary School Site Improvements Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $1,450 playground impact testing by B Safe at Madison Park Academy
enrichment.summary: B Safe Playground Inspection Services will perform impact testing and inspection of a playground structure for the Madison Park Academy Playmatting and Structure Project, for a lump sum. The Board is ratifying (approving after the fact) the agreement, and work was scheduled to start September 27, 2022, before this vote. It runs through December 31, 2022 and is paid from Measure J bond funds.

vendor.name: B Safe Playground Inspection Services, Inc.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Approves up to $96,000 agreement with KABOOM! to build a new play space at Global Family Elementary
enrichment.summary: The district is entering a Community Partner Playspace Agreement with KABOOM! to build a new play space at Global Family Elementary School. The amount is not to exceed $96,000 and the agreement runs October 1, 2022 through December 31, 2023. The funding source is listed as Measure J bond funds.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
